capabilities: Display the folder hierarchy of the current file in the editor
Customize tab titles to show full paths or file names
Customize backlink and linked-mention titles by path or file name
Exclude paths or shorten path prefixes in hierarchy labels
Keep hierarchy expansion state and refresh on note changes
disambiguation: Not a link-based note hierarchy builder; it visualizes vault folder paths in the editor, tab headers, and backlinks panel.
extras: The Tips section recommends pairing with Obsidian Linter and provides regex replacements to strip link aliases and a pages/ path prefix from links.
intentEvidence: Display hierarchy in backlinks panel: Toggle this setting to show the folder hierarchy of files in the backlinks panel
motivation: The author prefers organizing notes by folder paths over tags and wanted path context visible without cluttered link prefixes.
problem: Obsidian shows only file names in tabs and the backlinks panel, so you cannot see which folder a note belongs to at a glance.

relations.evidence: Some code around the backlinks are inspired by the Owner avatar better-search-views

summary: Folder-hierarchy display plugin that shows a file's folder structure in the editor and rewrites tab and backlink titles to show paths.
